owner: ARBITRATION §1 (as amended, drift ID-01) and seam S13 (as amended, wave 0)

why_this_exists.supreme_rule: Inside the fight, Souls wins. But Souls' authority inside the fight is over HOW FIGHTING WORKS, not over whether the world still exists while you are in one.
why_this_exists.S13_split: SOULS owns the fact that the browsable topic list is unavailable mid-swing — you do not open a keyword menu while a mace is coming down, and enemies shout rather than converse. MORROWIND owns the requirement that a fight against anything capable of speech has a NON-LETHAL EXIT.
why_this_exists.defect_clause: A humanoid faction NPC with no parley path is a DEFECT. Beasts and mindless things are exempt — they have no parley and Souls owns them entirely.
why_this_exists.what_this_is_not: Not a menu, not a pause, not a dialogue tree, not a dice roll on a skill. Opening a topic list mid-fight would be an AR-1 Souls-leakage failure (S14: menus do not pause the world during combat) and would break the fight's frame contract.

the_interaction.input: the `interact` button, pressed while a parleyable hostile is inside the arc and range below
the_interaction.shape: a COMMITTED, ANIMATED ACTION on exactly the same terms as every other action in the fight — it has startup, it has active frames, it has recovery, it costs you your defence, and nothing cancels it
the_interaction.stamina_rationale: Speaking costs no stamina (stamina.json free_always). What it costs is 78 f@60 of standing still inside a fight, which is a longer commitment than a straight-sword R1 and only 44 f shorter than its heavy. That is the price, and it is paid in the same currency as everything else: frames.
the_interaction.interrupted: any hit during frames 1-78 cancels the parley, applies normal damage and poise, and consumes the attempt for `refuse_cooldown_f`
the_interaction.arc_note: the parleying character must be facing the target and the target must be facing back — you cannot yield to something that is not looking at you
the_interaction.refuse_cooldown_note: 10 s. A refused parley is not retryable on the next frame; the enemy has heard you.

grounds._note: Four diegetic grounds, exactly as S13 names them: yield / offer gold / invoke a faction / speak a name you learned. Each is a DETERMINISTIC threshold test against out-of-fight state. There is no roll: S21 keeps the die where failure is permanent, and a refused parley is permanent (refuse_cooldown_f), but S1 forbids dice INSIDE the fight and the parley resolves inside it. The gate therefore lives in the world state (Morrowind) and the uncertainty lives in whether the player has done the work (Souls).

YIELD.fiction: You lower your weapon and step back. A person who is losing and knows it may take the offer.
YIELD.declines_if: the enemy's archetype declares honour_bound: true

GOLD.fiction: You put coin on the ground between you. ARBITRATION S15: gold is the only currency, and this is one of the things it buys.

FACTION.fiction: You name your rank in the order the two of you both serve.
FACTION.declines_if: the player is EXPELLED from that faction, or holds rank in a faction declared its rival

NAME.fiction: You speak a name the thing has not heard spoken by a stranger. This is the ground that has nothing to do with combat at all.

effects: the enemy de-aggros permanently for this encounter and will not re-aggro unless struck
the encounter's fight-boundary condition is satisfied without a corpse (ARBITRATION §1: killing is ONE exit from a fight, not the only one)
the enemy remains alive, remains in world.entities, keeps its quest role, and can still be talked to out of combat
no souls are awarded — you did not kill it
faction standing with the enemy's faction moves +2; standing with its declared rival moves -1
the enemy attacks immediately out of its next actionable frame
the ground that was tried is recorded so the same ground cannot be retried this encounter

EXEMPT.when: the target declares parley: null — a beast or a mindless thing
effects: the input is dropped, the animation does not start, no frames are spent, and the trace says why

seam_crossing.ar3_claim: This is W1-09's AR-3 crossing and it runs in BOTH directions.
seam_crossing.world_into_fight: quest.topicsKnown (a Morrowind dialogue/lore artifact, learned by reading a book or asking the right person the right keyword OUTSIDE the fight), quest.factions[*].rank, quest.dispositions[*] and the gold purse all decide, inside the fight, at 60 Hz, whether a hostile can be resolved without killing it. A player who read The Drowned Ford can end a fight a player who did not must win with a sword.
seam_crossing.fight_into_world: the outcome writes back: faction standing moves, the NPC survives to be a quest actor, and no soul drop occurs. A fight resolved by parley leaves the world in a state a fight resolved by killing cannot reach.
seam_crossing.why_it_is_not_sterile: AR-1 and AR-2 police leakage; they never ask whether the two halves touch. This one interaction makes a lore fact load-bearing on a combat outcome without importing a single Morrowind mechanic into the fight: no dice, no pause, no menu, no untelegraphed instant anything. It is a committed animated action with frame data, judged by geometry and state, exactly like a backstab.
